apis.name: book_auto_repair
apis.description: This API should be called when a user has identified a car issue that needs professional service and is ready to book an auto repair service. It allows the user to select the type of repair needed, provide vehicle information, and choose an appointment time at a repair shop.

apis.name: check_repair_availability
apis.description: This API should be called when a user is looking to find available time slots for vehicle repair. It helps users to determine when a repair shop can schedule their vehicle for service based on the shop's current bookings and opening hours.

apis.name: search_repair_shop
apis.description: This API should be called when a user is in need of finding a repair shop nearby or wanting to compare different shops for services offered, location, pricing, and customer reviews. It assists the user in locating a convenient and suitable auto repair facility.

available_parameters.name: name_store
available_parameters.description: The name of the auto repair store.

available_parameters.name: name_customer
available_parameters.description: The name of the customer requesting the auto repair service.

available_parameters.name: date_appt
available_parameters.description: The specific date the customer wishes to book for the auto repair appointment.

available_parameters.name: time_appt
available_parameters.description: The specific time of day for the scheduled auto repair appointment.

available_parameters.name: reason_appt
available_parameters.description: The reason for the auto repair appointment, which may include details about the type of service or repair needed.

available_parameters.name: name_vehicle
available_parameters.description: The make or model name of the vehicle that requires repair.

available_parameters.name: year_vehicle
available_parameters.description: The manufacturing year of the vehicle to provide context about its potential needs for the repair.

available_parameters.name: location_store
available_parameters.description: The geographical location or address of the auto repair store.
